rootCause:
Likely cause: AWS Glue Python jobs are experiencing persistent application-level errors in the /aws-glue/python-jobs/error log group.

Confidence: high

Supporting evidence: Finding c1ae6309 (application, high severity, 13 occurrences) and finding e6d73eb0 (application, high severity, 10 occurrences) represent the top two critical issues occurring in /aws-glue/python-jobs/error with overlapping timeframes from 2026-09-01T15:46:05Z through 2026-09-02T09:59:39Z (correlation IDs: abdf56d0, 882edd61, cbcee5e6, 0698fdb0, af2d5d95, 424f267b, ab292bb3). The category breakdown shows 9 of 20 total findings are categorized as "application" errors, with 7 concentrated in the Python-specific log group. The persistent recurrence across multiple application-level findings (1fcdeb20 with 7 occurrences, 6aad93f0 with 6 occurrences) over an 18-hour window indicates systemic rather than transient issues within Glue Python job execution.
executiveSummary:
- Is anything wrong: Yes, 20 findings detected with 2 high severity issues
- Biggest issue: Application errors in /aws-glue/python-jobs/error with 13 occurrences at high severity
- Where: 6 affected resource groups, primarily application category with 9 findings
- Recurring: Yes, clustered pattern with 7 findings at 12:00, 5 at 14:00, and 4 at 10:00
- Investigate first: Application errors in AWS Glue Python jobs log group for root cause of high severity incidents
